# "What to Test" for the next TestFlight build.
#
# Write the release's notes here as plain-words bullets, the same ones that go
# on the build's card in the command center. The staging pipeline uses this
# file only when it changed since the previous release; otherwise it falls back
# to summarising the feat/fix commits. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# App Store Connect allows at most 4000 characters.

Your community cards, kept by your agent
• Your membership and role cards now show in your Wallet, named for their community: "Member of …".
• Each card says whether your agent keeps a copy, or why it stays on this phone only.
• If a card goes missing from this phone, Manage → "Get your cards from your agent" brings it back.
• When a membership ends or a community withdraws a card, the community's card on "Your agent" says so.

Your phones, and a lost one
• A new phone links as a new device. Name it, then keep or remove your other phones: nothing is removed unless you choose.
• My devices shows each phone and when it last checked in. "Remove this phone" cuts its access at once; the removed phone then offers to erase its copy or link again.
• Lost a phone? Remove it, then change your identities' keys, so any copy it kept stops working. Your contacts and communities keep working.
• Your identities' keys stay with your agent. This phone borrows them only while the app is open, and never saves them.

More reliable joining
• Invitations a community sends from its console reach the app again.
• Joins and applications wait longer for a slow message instead of being lost, and a busy community is named as busy.
• After the app locks and you unlock it, your identities keep receiving messages without restarting the app.
• A Keyring vetter can now vet someone who uses the openvtc terminal app.

Clearer screens
• Communities are called by their name, never a server address, and each shows when you joined.
• The vetting desk opens on a new ticket and points you to sharing it once it's made.
• "Your agent" fits small phones and large text sizes.
• Pasting something that isn't a link now says so in plain words.
• The app is smaller to download.
• Update over your current version; there's no need to reinstall.
